title: Parametric helical coil spring (Three.js (Node.js))
seed: Build a script from scratch in Three.js (Node.js) that procedurally generates: Generate a coil spring as a tube mesh swept along a helical path (circling a central axis while rising steadily along it). Coil radius, tube (wire) radius, number of coils, total spring height, and path segment count must be CLI-configurable. Save to glb with deterministic seeding, CLI parameterization, and an independent post-save validation step.
